voices.name: l00
voices.text: Why did you do that? <#0.3#> Just because.
voices.caption: Why did you do that? Just because.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: But the truth is, <#0.2#> there is no just because.
voices.caption: But the truth is, there is no just because.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Every thought, word, action and feeling of the soul <#0.2#> has a reason.
voices.caption: Every thought, word, action and feeling of the soul has a reason.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Even a leaf on a pond <#0.2#> has roots beneath the water.
voices.caption: Even a leaf on a pond has roots beneath the water.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: I don't know the reason, <#0.2#> yet.
voices.caption: I don't know the reason, yet.
